recipe.visualDefinition: A central full-body portrait of a woman with outstretched arms, wearing a dress that perfectly matches a dense, black-background floral wallpaper. The entire scene is framed by a wide, solid yellow border with ornate script typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background camouflage through matching floral patterns
High-contrast relationship between the black floral field and the solid yellow frame
Symmetrical balance created by the subject's pose and centered typography
Integration of organic floral shapes with rigid rectangular framing
coreInvariants: Black-ground floral pattern with yellow and white irises
Subject's arms extended horizontally to create a 'T' shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, full-length figure occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and dark hat, positioned at the upper-center of the floral field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, moves down to the face, follows the horizontal line of the arms, descends through the dress to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid yellow in the outer margins to focus attention on the central square.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow used for the outer frame and floral highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black used for the wallpaper background and the subject's hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy white used for the petals of the iris flowers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black core and yellow frame; mid-range saturation for a vintage 1970s feel.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients in the yellow frame

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of 'whip-lash' curves and elongated terminals
Thick-to-thin stroke modulation characteristic of a broad-nib pen
Interlocking swashes that cradle the word forms
Vertical stress with rounded, bulbous counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase initials feature oversized loops that extend above and below the x-height
Descenders on lowercase letters curve back to underline the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image of a woman in a wide-brimmed hat with arms outstretched, wearing a dress that matches a black-background yellow iris wallpaper. Place this square inside a thick solid yellow border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom vector lettering in a black, ornate 1970s script style to the top and bottom yellow margins, centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Does the dress pattern blend into the background?
Is the yellow frame a solid, flat color?
Are the swashes on the typography sufficiently ornate?
Is the subject's pose perfectly centered?

adjustableVariables: Subject's specific pose (as long as it is symmetrical)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless pattern matching between clothing and wall

postGenerationChecks: Check for pattern continuity between subject and background
Ensure typography is black and centered
Verify the yellow border is uniform
Confirm the subject's arms are extended horizontally
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square camouflage portrait + Solid high-contrast border + Ornate swash typography
